summary: Snowshoer disoriented in a whiteout on Bald Mountain stepped off a 20-30 ft overhanging cornice and slid ~900 ft; while trying to climb out he triggered a D1 storm-slab avalanche (caught and carried, not buried) and then a second smaller avalanche; he called 911 and Summit County Rescue Group extracted him back to the ridgeline with a rope system, uninjured
notes: SnowBrains article parent-opened run 721; quotes the CAIC preliminary report. Date per article 'On April 28'; article published ~2024-05-03 (last-updated pin) -> year 2024; 2024-04-28 was a Sunday. Dedupe clean: zero Summit rows 2024-04-25..05-02; distinct from id 2694 (2023-04-29 Bald Mountain avalanche fatality).
